title: A customer question about Linux Desktop Client

question.author: member_258
question.body: I need a short answer about linux desktop client. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: Supported distributions are Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer and Fedora 36 or newer; both .deb packages and AppImages are provided. The Linux client has feature parity with the Windows and macOS clients, including selective sync and bandwidth throttling. Older forum posts stating that Linux is unsupported refer to versions before 2.0. CloudBox has shipped an official Linux desktop client since version 2.0 (September 2023). That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
